description: Every source the Hanogt AI fine-tuning set may use. Only sources with status 'allowed' are imported; 'review' sources need their dataset card's provenance read and recorded here first; 'excluded' sources are listed so they aren't proposed again. Licenses allowed: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, ODC-BY-1.0. Not allowed: non-commercial (NC), share-alike (SA), unknown licenses, and data generated with closed models whose terms forbid training other models.
